title: The life of a task, in the six state words

blocks.text: Each dashed box is one of the six words that you see. Each rounded box inside it is a state that the tool records. An arrow from a group's edge works from every state in that group.

blocks.title: The life of a task, in the six state words
blocks.key: Key: ● is the start. Left out: replan (a round that fixed nothing goes back to a new brief) and pr-ready (like verified). A study goes from verifying to concluded. Verified shows as in progress when autopilot merges it. 13 of the 15 states are drawn.
